thread:
mica: Heads-up — CI perf alert from last night's run. p95 for small-batch bench is ~+35% vs baseline. ci-bot posted details.
ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf-ci | bench-smallbatch | p95 +35% | job 2024-08-06-02. logs: https://ci.redwood/jenkins/12345
mica: Can someone grab a profiling slot on the kvcache host (kv-host-09) and run a lightweight perf trace? suspect KV cache eviction hot path.
ashley: I can do it in ~45m. do we have a bisect candidate? iirc commit 4a7d3b touched buckets/alloc.
sam: I'll try to repro locally now — `./dev/bench --mode smallbatch --seed 42` and attach flamegraph if it reproduces.
lorenzo: FYI I added a quick grafana panel: /d/abc/nightly-smallbatch — p95 series. spike begins ~01:23 UTC.
mica: thanks. @sam if you get a flamegraph paste it to https://files.redwood/fg/ then we'll decide perf vs kernel-trace.
sam: repro succeeded locally. uploading flamegraph: https://files.redwood/fg/1738800912.svg
sam: quick snapshot: top stack shows `kv_cache::evict` -> `kv_index::rehash` -> `alloc::grow`. smells like rehash/resize churn.
mica: ash — can you run on kv-host-09: `sudo perf record -g -p $(pidof redwood-runtime) -o /tmp/perf.data -- sleep 30` then `perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.fold && flamegraph.pl out.fold > out.svg` ?
ashley: on it, will post results when done.
dev-bot: Deploy bot: nightly-bench/2024-08-06 triggered by cron. JobID: 2024-08-06-02. Status: failed (p95 regression).
mica: Also keep canary fallback enabled (route to model-light) while we triage.
lorenzo: adding infra check for kernel logs/oom messages: https://alerts.redwood/incident/807 — tagging infra on-call.
ashley: perf run finished. uploaded /tmp/out.svg -> https://files.redwood/fg/1738801500.svg . main hotspot is allocation heavy in `buckets::insert`.
sam: flamegraph matches — allocation churn increased after the allocator tweak in candidate commit.
mica: next steps: @sam open a small PR with a perf test and revert candidate if CI confirms. @ash run a kernel trace if we need deeper syscalls (e.g., futex/alloc stalls). I'll update the incident and keep watch.
ashley: quick datapoint — `echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches` reduced p95 in my repro by ~12% (not a fix but useful clue).
sam: creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4821 — includes bench and perf baseline.
mica: great. if the alert comes back ping me directly. closing the immediate triage for now, will reopen if regression persists :thumbsup:
_notes: Thread contains root message and replies in chronological order. Short, informal Slack style with commands, links, and bot entries.
